title: 第259章 大劫之中皆是输家第260章 英雄归尘土
slug: 凡人修仙我百世轮回成道祖
content_zh:
陈默缓缓跪倒在地，
泪水悄然滴落，
砸在脚下染血的土地上，晕开一朵朵深色的花。
他从未哭过。
百世轮回，
他见过尸山血海，见过至亲惨死，见过王朝覆灭，早已将情绪磨得如同钢铁般坚硬。
他以为时间早已冲刷掉所有过往，
每一世的他都是全新的自己，
所有的一切早就已经过去，
可直到此刻。
孟章以身殉道时释然的笑容，
“老友，你安全便好。”
丫丫回头时温柔的眼神，
“师傅，这次换我保护你。”
关山月消散前那句：
“一定要来”，
林婉儿挥剑自刎时空洞的脸庞……
一张张脸在他脑海中交替闪过，清晰得仿佛就在昨日。
原来他从未忘记。
原来这些人，

早已跨越了轮回的界限，将他刻进了自己的骨血里。
这些死去的记忆，
突然之间复活，
而他，
却只能眼睁睁看着他们一个个离去，什么也做不了。
一股深入骨髓的苍凉与绝望，
如同潮水般将他彻底淹没。
千万天骄入众邪，如今只剩他一人独活。
这胜利，
来得太过沉重，
太过惨烈！
“嗷呜~喵！”
“主人，别难过！”
猫胆缓缓浮现，
声音带着一丝沙哑的安慰，
“无极魔神当年修炼到羽化之境，早已能化腐朽为神奇，逆改阴阳！
等你日后也登临那个境界，未必不能将这株桃树点化，唤醒丫丫的真灵！”
content_en:
Chen Mo slowly knelt down on the ground,
Tears fell quietly,
It hit the blood-stained ground underfoot, causing dark flowers to bloom.
He never cried.
Hundreds of reincarnations,
He has seen mountains of corpses and seas of blood, seen the tragic deaths of his loved ones, and seen the collapse of dynasties, and his emotions have long been tempered as hard as steel.
He thought that time had already washed away all the past,
He is a brand new self in every life,
Everything has passed long ago,
But until now.
Meng Zhang’s relieved smile when he died as a martyr,
"Old friend, just be safe."
Yaya's gentle eyes when she looked back,
"Master, let me protect you this time."
The words before Guan Shanyue dissipated:
"Must come",
Lin Wan'er's empty face when she swung her sword to kill herself...
Faces flashed through his mind alternately, as clearly as if it was yesterday.
It turns out he never forgot.
It turns out that these people,
He has already crossed the boundaries of reincarnation and carved him into his own bones and blood.
These dead memories,
suddenly resurrected,
And he,
But he could only watch them leave one by one, unable to do anything.
A desolation and despair that goes deep into the bone marrow,
It was like a tide that completely submerged him.
Thousands of talented people have joined the evil, and now he is the only one left to survive.
This victory,
It came too heavy,
Too tragic!
"Oooh~ Meow!"
"Master, don't be sad!"
Cat bile slowly emerged,
There was a hint of hoarse comfort in the voice,
"The Wuji Demon God cultivated to the realm of emergence, and he has already been able to turn decay into magic and reverse yin and yang!
When you reach that realm in the future, you may not be able to enlighten this peach tree and awaken Yaya’s true spirit! "
